fact: Run Plan Review Gate BEFORE implementing work units, not after. The gate catches issues before code is written, preventing rework.
why: Retroactive review found a spec bug that required a fix commit. Pre-implementation review would have caught it sooner.

fact: When a spec lists 'modules in scope', verify each module has corresponding implementation artifacts. Specs written during planning may list modules that don't need artifacts.
why: Permissions spec listed Authentication as in-scope but no authentication:* codes were needed - Auth endpoints are unauthenticated or just require identity.

fact: Alembic down_revision must exactly match the revision string of the parent migration (e.g., '0001_baseline' not '0001'). Mismatched IDs cause KeyError.
why: Migration failed with KeyError: '0001' because parent revision was '0001_baseline'. Exact string match required.

fact: The 3-reviewer Plan Review Gate (Feasibility, Completeness, Scope & Alignment) catches spec inconsistencies that implementation alone would miss.
why: Scope reviewer found Authentication listed in spec but implementation had Seed - a spec bug not visible from code alone.

fact: Authentication module has no permission codes by design. Login is public, GET /auth/me requires authentication but no specific permission. Don't add placeholder permissions.
why: Adding unused authentication:* permissions would be scope creep. Auth endpoints gate on identity existence, not permission codes.

fact: When using Pydantic ConfigDict(from_attributes=True), computed fields (e.g., permission_count, user_count) must be @property methods on the SQLAlchemy model for automatic serialization.
why: Adversarial review caught that service returned raw Role objects but schema expected permission_count/user_count - fix was adding @property to model.

fact: When a feature depends on an unbuilt module, return a documented stub (e.g., user_count=0) with docstring explaining what changes when dependency is built. Add 'Deferred behavior' section to work-units.md.
why: Roles module needed user_count but Users module doesn't exist yet. Stub with documentation prevents rework later.

fact: Use selectinload(Parent.children).selectinload(Child.grandchild) to eagerly load nested relationships. Executes 2-3 batched queries total instead of N+1.
why: list_roles needed permission_count without N+1 queries. selectinload preloads role_permissions and permissions in constant queries.

fact: Define service exceptions with status_code, error_code, and extra fields on AppException base. Routers use single _map_exception_to_http() helper for uniform HTTP error responses.
why: Established pattern for Roles module - all service errors map to structured JSON with error_code field for frontend handling.

fact: Frontend modules requiring new npm packages must include a WU-0 work unit for dependency installation before any code work. Unlike backend (requirements.txt installed once), npm packages need explicit install step per module.
why: Frontend Shell module needed lucide-react and clsx. Adding WU-SHELL-0 for npm install ensured dependencies were ready before component code.

fact: Before writing work-units.md, glob for existing files in file scope. Mark existing files as UPDATE not CREATE to prevent confusion when plans reference files that already exist.
why: Frontend Shell plan marked AppShell.tsx and routes/index.tsx as CREATE but they already existed. Feasibility review caught this, requiring file scope corrections.

fact: Plan Review Gate Feasibility reviewer must independently verify dependency claims by checking package.json - never trust 'already installed' statements in plans without verification.
why: Plan claimed lucide-react was 'already in project dependencies' but npm ls showed it wasn't. Independent verification caught the error before implementation.

fact: Password utility (hash_password/verify_password) has zero upstream dependencies and can be implemented early to unblock Users module. It's a pure utility.
why: Users WU-USR-3 depends on hash_password. Implementing WU-AUTH-2 first (which only depends on Project Setup) unblocks the dependency without waiting for full Auth module.

fact: Modules without cross-dependencies (like Accounts and Users) can be implemented in parallel using sub-agents. This significantly reduces wall-clock time.
why: Accounts (WU-ACCT-1,2,3) and Users (WU-USR-1,2,3,4,5) were implemented in parallel, reducing total time by ~50%.

fact: Plan Review Gate iteration: when reviewers FAIL, fix work-units.md, then spawn completely fresh reviewer instances. Never pass previous findings to new reviewers to avoid anchoring bias.
why: Users failed first gate (Feasibility + Completeness). After fixing 5 completeness gaps and noting the hash_password resolution, fresh reviewers all passed on iteration 2.

fact: HTTPException responses from FastAPI dependencies (OAuth2, etc.) are NOT wrapped in the response envelope. Test with data["detail"] not envelope["error"]["code"]. Only AppException subclasses go through the custom handler.
why: Auth integration tests failed because they expected envelope format for 401 responses from OAuth2 dependencies, but HTTPException bypasses AppException handler.

fact: CORS middleware must be added LAST in FastAPI (runs first in request chain). ResponseEnvelopeMiddleware must skip OPTIONS requests to preserve CORS headers. Also: allow_credentials=True requires explicit origins, not wildcard.
why: CORS preflight failed because ResponseEnvelopeMiddleware consumed the response and stripped CORS headers. Middleware order and OPTIONS handling are critical.

fact: When Pydantic field_validator raises ValueError with extra context (like enum values), error ctx dictionary values may not be JSON serializable. Sanitize by converting all ctx values to strings before JSON encoding in validation_exception_handler.
why: 500 error on validation because ctx contained Enum objects. Fix: str(v) for all ctx values in the exception handler.

fact: When TypeScript verbatimModuleSyntax is enabled, type-only imports must use 'import type { X }' syntax. Mixing types in value imports (e.g., DragEndEvent from @dnd-kit/core) causes TS1484 error.
why: Build failed with TS1484 for DragEndEvent/DragStartEvent. Split into 'import { DndContext }' and 'import type { DragEndEvent }' to fix.

fact: Tests expecting response envelope format must access response['data'] not response['items']. ResponseEnvelopeMiddleware transforms the 'items' key from paginated responses into the standard 'data' field.
why: 12 tests failed with KeyError: 'items'. The envelope middleware renames items->data for consistency.

fact: When React component props are typed but intentionally unused (placeholder tabs, future features), prefix parameter with underscore (_contactId) to satisfy no-unused-vars linter without removing the type contract.
why: ContactEmailsTab and ContactHistoryTab needed contactId in signature for future use but weren't using it yet. Underscore prefix is the TypeScript/ESLint convention.
